svg.title: Uniform over the cap
svg.desc: Two top-down views of a cone's cap with 700 sample directions each. Drawing the angle uniformly crowds samples near the axis; drawing its cosine uniformly spreads them evenly. A worked example gives the median direction of the demo's 0.35 radian cone as 0.2469 radians, not 0.175.
svg.text: The cone seen down its axis. Equal steps in angle are rings of unequal area.
uniform in θ: crowded at the axis
uniform in cos θ: equal density
uniform in θ would say 0.175 rad
is lost to a subtraction near 1
Drawn at θmax = 40° so the rings can be seen; 700 samples each, from pcg_hash.
